notes: Full-life case: operation until year 25 (wind) or 30 (solar), Fraunhofer ISE 2024 lifetimes; the years after the EEG period earn today's market value (SMARD capture price of the last 12 months), held flat.

Base case: revenue counts only the EEG award value for 20 years (wind: award × correction factor as estimated in awards.json; solar: average award of the round). Market prices above the award, operation after year 20 and residual value are not counted.
Pre-tax, nominal. No trade tax, no balancing or direct marketing income, no curtailment compensation.
Yields come from our DWD-based model (wind: calibrated full-load hours; solar: radiation × performance ratio); individual sites can differ substantially.
